summary:
Implemented TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo, but nothing was run and one test is known to be failing until regenerated.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: new TimeElapsedColumn (between BarColumn and TimeRemainingColumn); new Task.finished_time field after _get_time; Task.finished now returns finished_time is not None; Task._reset clears finished_time; Progress.update and Progress.advance capture elapsed as finished_time when completed >= total and nothing is captured yet; Progress.reset clears finished_time before refresh.
- rich/default_styles.py: "progress.elapsed": Style(color="yellow").
- CHANGELOG.md: [Unreleased] / Added entry for Progress.TimeElapsedColumn.
- tests/test_progress.py: imports TimeElapsedColumn; new test_time_elapsed_column (unstarted, running, finished-frozen cases); TimeElapsedColumn added to the test_columns column list.

Not done:
- test_columns expected output is stale. Adding the column shifts bar widths and adds live elapsed cells; I did not hand-derive the bytes. It must be regenerated by running that test and checking against the spec.
- No tests were run, per instructions, so all changes are unverified by execution.

Choices: column placed after TimeRemainingColumn in test_columns; capture in update runs after the existing refresh call, following the spec's ordering of after samples are applied.
